clips.title: The story
paras: Overlord Ramtusk is a massive quilboar warlord who leads the warriors deep within Razorfen Kraul. Crying out for victory and for Agamaggan, he fights at the head of his elite guards, and striking him down shatters the martial backbone of the Kraul's defenders.

Overlord Ramtusk holds command deep within the thorny maze of Razorfen Kraul, the quilboar stronghold in the southern Barrens. He goes into battle with a war cry to the boar demigod Agamaggan, and he rules the Kraul's fighters with unyielding authority.
